# Second Quarter Results for the Fiscal Year Ending March 31, 2027

Seabright Foods Co., Ltd.

Release date: November 10, 2026

Reporting period: April 1, 2026 to September 30, 2026 (Q2, six months)

Earnings call: November 12, 2026 (head office and online)

## 1 Results for the first six months

Net sales of Seabright Foods Co., Ltd. for the six months rose 10.0% to $2,640 million from $2,400 million a year earlier.

| Item | Six months a year earlier | Q2 FY2027 (six months) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Net sales | $2,400 million | $2,640 million |
| Operating profit | $168 million | $198 million |
| Operating margin | 7.0% | 7.5% |
| Net profit | $110 million | $130 million |

## 2 Net sales by segment

(In millions of US dollars)

| Segment | Six months a year earlier | Q2 FY2027 (six months) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Packaged foods | 1,350 | 1,480 |
| Frozen foods | 780 | 860 |
| Food service | 270 | 300 |
| Total | 2,400 | 2,640 |

## 3 Revised full-year forecast

Sales of packaged foods are strong, so we are revising upward the full-year forecast announced in May 2026, as follows.

(In millions of US dollars)

| Item | Previous forecast | Revised forecast |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Net sales | 5,200 | 5,400 |
| Operating profit | 380 | 410 |
